title: Define animated bounds and culling policy for skinned meshes
description:
## Summary
Define and implement the animated bounds and culling policy for CreatureSkinnedMeshRenderer output.

## User Mandate
> Please take everything from this good branch and take over for this agent:

STRICT. Preserve the uncaptured animated-bounds and culling finding from the reviewed follow-up branch without importing its raw task JSON or duplicate records.

## Scope
- Establish ownership and update policy for SkinnedMeshRenderer.localBounds during animated deformation.
- Define the relationship between conservative bounds, runtime culling, updateWhenOffscreen, and generated creature scale.
- Preserve the authoritative DNA and derived-mesh ownership model; do not make bounds an alternate geometry authority.
- Keep this separate from the already-delivered same-count skeleton compatibility guard, while coordinating with TSK-0132 and TSK-0142.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Animated geometry remains visible under the documented culling policy for representative poses and deformations.
- Bounds behavior is deterministic, finite, and testable without relying on undocumented Unity defaults.
- The chosen policy has focused runtime/editor coverage and a measured performance tradeoff.
- No duplicate binding-compatibility task or imported branch-local TSK-0203 collision is created.

## Validation
Run whole-project .NET compilation, focused runtime/editor tests, and Unity PlayMode/manual culling validation with console inspection. Record exact results and Unity availability.

## Findings
The reviewed follow-up branch identified that localBounds and updateWhenOffscreen behavior for animated generated meshes is currently undefined. Its branch-local task records contained a duplicate TSK-0203 key and must not be imported.

## Blockers
No implementation or Unity execution has been performed for this finding.

## Next Step
Choose a conservative bounds policy, add a posed deformation fixture, and measure culling correctness and per-frame cost.

## Reconciliation
Renumbered from TSK-0200 on 2026-09-12. TSK-0200 now resolves uniquely to the in-progress sparse root-envelope SDF sampling task tsk-0200-sparse-root-envelope-sdf-sampling; this record keeps the animated-bounds and culling policy.
